```{r}
value_box_data <- stats_period %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~if_else(field_time == 0 & total_distance == 0, NA_real_, .x))) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(position_name != "Goal Keeper" & date == training_date) %>%
  group_by(athlete_name) %>%
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric) & !max_vel_kph, ~sum(.x, na.rm=T)), max_vel_kph=max(max_vel_kph,na.rm=T)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~mean(.x, na.rm=T)))

total_distance <- value_box_data %>% pull(total_distance)

hsr_distance <- value_box_data %>% pull(high_speed_distance)

sprint_distance <- value_box_data %>% pull(sprint_distance)

accel_efforts <- value_box_data %>% pull(accel_efforts)

decel_efforts <- value_box_data %>% pull(decel_efforts)

max_vel <- value_box_data %>% pull(max_vel_kph)

```



```{r}
distance_group_avg_stats <- stats_period %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~if_else(field_time == 0 & total_distance == 0, NA_real_, .x))) %>%
      # drop_na(field_time) %>%
      select(athlete_name | date | tag_name | position_name | period_name | total_distance | high_speed_distance | sprint_distance) %>%
      dplyr::filter(position_name != "Goal Keeper" &  date <= training_date & date >= (training_date-days(6))) %>%
  mutate(tag_name=if_else(is.na(tag_name),"OFF", tag_name)) %>%
        # drop_na(tag_name) %>%
     group_by(date, tag_name, athlete_name) %>%
     summarize(across(where(is.numeric),  ~sum(.x, na.rm=T))) %>%
      group_by(date,tag_name) %>%
      summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~mean(.x,na.rm=T))) %>%
      ungroup %>%
    mutate(across(c(high_speed_distance, sprint_distance), ~.x*20)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=contains("distance"), names_to = "Type", values_to = "Distance") %>%
  mutate(Type=factor(Type, levels=c("total_distance", "high_speed_distance", "sprint_distance")),
         Distance_labels = if_else(Type != "total_distance", round(Distance/20), round(Distance)),
         MD_label_y = max(Distance, na.rm=T))



distance_group_avg_plot <- distance_group_avg_stats %>% 
      ggplot() +
      geom_col(aes(x=date, y=Distance,fill=Type), position=position_dodge2(width=0.9,preserve = "single")) +
       geom_text(aes(x=date, y=Distance,group =Type, label =Distance_labels),size=4, vjust = -0.5, color="#221C35", position=position_dodge2(width=0.9,preserve = "single")) +
  geom_text(aes(x=date, y=MD_label_y, group =Type, label =tag_name),size=4, vjust = -5, color="#221C35") +
      labs(x=NULL, y ="Total Distance (m)",fill=NULL)+
  theme_bw()+
      scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day",date_labels = "%a")+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2)), sec.axis = sec_axis(~./20, name="HSR / Sprint Distance (m)"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#00B0B9","#572C5F","#B2C9D4"),labels = c("Total Distance", "HSR Distance", "Sprint Distance"))+ 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",legend.direction = "horizontal",panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.x=element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.text  = element_text(colour = "#221C35", size=12),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "#221C35", size=14),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "#221C35", size=12),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "#221C35", fill = "transparent"),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "#221C35"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(colour = "#221C35"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(colour = "#221C35")
 )
  
      
 ggsave("plot.svg",distance_group_avg_plot, dpi = 600, width = 6, height = 6)
```

```{r}

  
md_benchmarks <- stats %>% 
  filter(date > as.Date("2026-03-30") & tag_name == "MD" & position_name != "Goal Keepers" & field_time > 0 & total_distance > 0) %>% 
  select(athlete_name, date, field_time, total_distance, high_speed_distance, sprint_distance, accel_decel_efforts) %>% 
  mutate(hs_distance = high_speed_distance+sprint_distance, .keep="unused") %>% 
  relocate(hs_distance, .after=total_distance) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !field_time, ~.x/(field_time/60), .names="{.col}_per_min")) %>%
  select(!field_time) %>% 
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~mean(.x, na.rm=T)))

session_volume_intensity <- stats %>% 
  filter(date==training_date & position_name != "Goal Keepers" & field_time > 0 & total_distance > 0) %>% 
  select(athlete_name, date, field_time, total_distance, high_speed_distance, sprint_distance, accel_decel_efforts) %>% 
  mutate(hs_distance = high_speed_distance+sprint_distance, .keep="unused") %>% 
  relocate(hs_distance, .after=total_distance) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !field_time, ~.x/(field_time/60), .names="{.col}_per_min")) %>%
  select(!field_time) %>% 
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), ~mean(.x, na.rm=T)))


md_comparison_metrics <- session_volume_intensity/md_benchmarks


md_comparison <- md_comparison_metrics %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(volume = mean(c_across(!contains("per_min")), na.rm = T), 
         intensity = mean(c_across(contains("per_min")), na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(overall=volume*intensity)
```

```{=typst}
// 1. THE ARCH GAUGE FUNCTION (Slightly increased 100% text label size)
#let progressive-gauge(
  percentage,
  label: none,
  size: 60pt,
  stroke-width: 5.5pt,
  color: rgb("#00B0B9"),
) = {
  let max-val = calc.max(percentage, 100)
  let val = calc.max(percentage, 0)
  let gauge-color = color
  let center-pt = size / 2
  let radius = (size - stroke-width) / 2
  let start-angle = 135deg
  let total-sweep = 270deg
  let target-100-sweep = (100 / max-val) * total-sweep
  let steps = 60
  
  block(
    width: size,
    height: size,
    {
      // Gray Track
      for i in range(0, steps) {
        let angle1 = start-angle + (i / steps) * total-sweep
        let angle2 = start-angle + ((i + 1) / steps) * total-sweep
        let x1 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle1)
        let y1 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle1)
        let x2 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle2)
        let y2 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle2)
        place(line(start: (x1, y1), end: (x2, y2), stroke: (paint: rgb("#e2e8f0"), thickness: stroke-width, cap: "round")))
      }
      
      // Progress Track
      if val > 0 {
        let fg-steps = calc.ceil((val / max-val) * steps)
        for i in range(0, fg-steps) {
          let t1 = i / steps
          let t2 = calc.min((i + 1) / steps, val / max-val)
          let angle1 = start-angle + t1 * total-sweep
          let angle2 = start-angle + t2 * total-sweep
          let x1 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle1)
          let y1 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle1)
          let x2 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle2)
          let y2 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle2)
          place(line(start: (x1, y1), end: (x2, y2), stroke: (paint: gauge-color, thickness: stroke-width, cap: "round")))
        }
      }
      
      // 100% Target Divider Line (Increased text ratio from 0.07 to 0.085)
      if percentage > 100 {
        let target-angle = start-angle + target-100-sweep
        let inner-r = radius - (stroke-width * 0.8)
        let outer-r = radius + (stroke-width * 0.8)
        let tx1 = center-pt + inner-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let ty1 = center-pt + inner-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        let tx2 = center-pt + outer-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let ty2 = center-pt + outer-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        place(line(start: (tx1, ty1), end: (tx2, ty2), stroke: (paint: rgb("#1e293b"), thickness: 1.2pt, cap: "round")))
        let text-r = outer-r + 3pt
        let text-x = center-pt + text-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let text-y = center-pt + text-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        place(top + left, dx: text-x, dy: text-y - 2.5pt, text(size: size * 0.085, fill: rgb("#1e293b"), weight: "bold", "100%"))
      }
      
      // Midpoint Text Stack
      place(
        top + left,
        dx: center-pt,
        dy: center-pt - (size * 0.02), 
        block(width: 0pt, height: 0pt, {
          align(center + horizon)[
            #block(width: size)[
              #text(size: size * 0.20, weight: "bold")[#str(val)%] \
              #if label != none {
                text(size: size * 0.095, fill: rgb("#64748b"), weight: "bold")[#upper(label)]
              }
            ]
          ]
        })
      )
    }
  )
}

// 2. THE COMPACT METRIC BAR INDICATOR
#let bar-indicator(percentage, label: none, color: rgb("#00B0B9")) = {
  let max-val = calc.max(percentage, 100)
  let val = calc.max(percentage, 0)
  let bar-color = color
  
  box(
    stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("e5e5e5"),
    inset: (top: 7pt, left: 8pt, right: 8pt, bottom: 10pt), 
    radius: 4pt,  
    fill: rgb("fafafa"),
    width: 100%,
    [
      #grid(
        columns: (auto, 1fr, auto),
        column-gutter: 4pt,
        text(weight: "bold", size: 7.5pt, fill: rgb("2c3e50"))[#label], 
        align(left + horizon)[#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "medium", fill: rgb("#64748b"))[(#val)]], 
        align(right + horizon)[#text(size: 7.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1e293b"))[#str(val)%]]
      )
      #v(2pt) 
      
      #align(left)[
        #block(
          width: 100%,
          height: 4.5pt, 
          {
            // 1. Gray Background Track
            place(top + left, rect(width: 100%, height: 4.5pt, fill: rgb("#e2e8f0"), radius: 2.2pt))
            
            // 2. Overlapping Progress Strip
            if val > 0 {
              let fill-width = calc.min((val / max-val) * 100, 100)
              place(top + left, rect(width: fill-width * 1%, height: 4.5pt, fill: bar-color, radius: 2.2pt))
            }
            
            // 3. Conditional 100% Line Marker & Text Label
            if percentage > 100 {
              let marker-pos = (100 / max-val) * 100
              
              // Vertical marker line intersecting the bar
              place(
                top + left, 
                dx: marker-pos * 1% - 1.2pt, 
                dy: -1.2pt, 
                rect(width: 1.2pt, height: 7pt, fill: rgb("#1e293b"), radius: 0.5pt)
              )
              
              // Small text indicator overlaid below
              place(
                top + left,
                dx: marker-pos * 1% - 8pt, 
                dy: 7.5pt,       
                text(size: 5.5pt, fill: rgb("#1e293b"), weight: "bold", "100%")
              )
            }
          }
        )
      ]
    ]
  )
}
```

```{r}


player_daily_summary <- stats_period %>% 
      dplyr::filter(position_name != "Goal Keeper" & date == training_date) %>%
      select(position_name, athlete_name, period_name, total_distance, high_speed_distance, sprint_distance, accel_efforts, decel_efforts,meterage_per_minute,max_vel_kph, percentage_max_velocity, field_time) %>% 
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~if_else(field_time == 0 & total_distance == 0, NA_real_, .x)),
             field_time=field_time/60,
             percentage_max_velocity=percentage_max_velocity/100
             ) %>% 
  group_by(athlete_name, position_name) %>% 
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric) & !max_vel_kph & !percentage_max_velocity, ~sum(.x,na.rm=T)), 
            across(max_vel_kph | percentage_max_velocity, ~ max(.x, na.rm=T))) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(meterage_per_minute= total_distance/field_time) %>% 
  rename(Position=position_name, Player = athlete_name, `Total Distance (m)` = total_distance, `HSR Distance (m)` = high_speed_distance, `Sprint Distance (m)` = sprint_distance, `Accel Efforts` = accel_efforts, `Decel Efforts`=decel_efforts, `Avg Speed (m/min)` = meterage_per_minute, `Max Speed (km/h)` = max_vel_kph, `Max Speed (%max)` = percentage_max_velocity) %>% 
  mutate(
    `Max Speed (%max)` = scales::percent(`Max Speed (%max)`, accuracy =0.1),
    across(where(is.numeric) & ! `Max Speed (km/h)`, round), 
    `Max Speed (km/h)`=round(`Max Speed (km/h)`,1)
  ) %>%
      drop_na(Position) %>% 
  select(!Position & !field_time)

# Custom function with dynamic color arguments
ggplot_progress_bar <- function(x, data_column, bar_fill = "#00B0B9", bar_outline = "#FFFFFF", text_color = "#FFFFFF", ...) {
  min_limit <- min(data_column, na.rm=T)
  max_limit <- max(data_column, na.rm=T)
  scaled <- (x-min_limit)/(max_limit-min_limit)
  # scaled <- x/max_limit

  df <- data.frame(val = x, scaled = scaled, max_val = 1)
  
  p <- ggplot(df) +
    #Background bar
    geom_col(aes(x = max_val, y = 1), fill = "transparent", linewidth =1, color = bar_outline, width = 0.2) +
    #Foreground bar 
    geom_col(aes(x = scaled, y = 1), fill = bar_fill, linewidth =1,color = bar_outline, width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(x = max_val/2, y = 1, label = val), color=text_color, hjust = "middle",fontface="bold", size = 16) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.01,0.01)) +
    theme_void()

}
```

```{=typst}
// 1. THE ARCH GAUGE FUNCTION
#let progressive-gauge(
  percentage, 
  label: none, 
  size: 110pt, 
  stroke-width: 10pt,
  color: rgb("#00B0B9"), 
  // thresholds: (40, 85, 100),
  // colors: (rgb("#22c55e"), rgb("#eab308"), rgb("#ef4444"), rgb("#a855f7"))
) = {
  let max-val = calc.max(percentage, 100)
  let val = calc.max(percentage, 0)
  
  // let gauge-color = if val <= thresholds.at(0) { colors.at(0) }
  //  else if val <= thresholds.at(1) { colors.at(1) }
  //  else if val <= thresholds.at(2) { colors.at(2) }
  //  else { colors.at(3) }

  let gauge-color = color 
  
  
  let center-pt = size / 2
  let radius = (size - stroke-width) / 2
  
  let start-angle = 135deg
  let total-sweep = 270deg
  let target-100-sweep = (100 / max-val) * total-sweep
  let steps = 60

  block(
    width: size,
    height: size,
    {
      // Gray Track
      for i in range(0, steps) {
        let angle1 = start-angle + (i / steps) * total-sweep
        let angle2 = start-angle + ((i + 1) / steps) * total-sweep
        let x1 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle1)
        let y1 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle1)
        let x2 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle2)
        let y2 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle2)
        place(line(start: (x1, y1), end: (x2, y2), stroke: (paint: rgb("#e2e8f0"), thickness: stroke-width, cap: "round")))
      }
      
      // Progress Track
      if val > 0 {
        let fg-steps = calc.ceil((val / max-val) * steps)
        for i in range(0, fg-steps) {
          let t1 = i / steps
          let t2 = calc.min((i + 1) / steps, val / max-val)
          let angle1 = start-angle + t1 * total-sweep
          let angle2 = start-angle + t2 * total-sweep
          let x1 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle1)
          let y1 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle1)
          let x2 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle2)
          let y2 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle2)
          place(line(start: (x1, y1), end: (x2, y2), stroke: (paint: gauge-color, thickness: stroke-width, cap: "round")))
        }
      }
      
      // 100% Target Divider Line
      if percentage > 100 {
        let target-angle = start-angle + target-100-sweep
        let inner-r = radius - (stroke-width * 0.8)
        let outer-r = radius + (stroke-width * 0.8)
        let tx1 = center-pt + inner-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let ty1 = center-pt + inner-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        let tx2 = center-pt + outer-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let ty2 = center-pt + outer-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        place(line(start: (tx1, ty1), end: (tx2, ty2), stroke: (paint: rgb("#1e293b"), thickness: 2pt, cap: "round")))
        
        let text-r = outer-r + 6pt
        let text-x = center-pt + text-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let text-y = center-pt + text-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        place(top + left, dx: text-x, dy: text-y - 4pt, text(size: size * 0.07, fill: rgb("#1e293b"), weight: "bold", "100%"))
      }
      
      // Midpoint Text Stack
      place(
        top + left, dx: center-pt, dy: center-pt - (size * 0.1), 
        block(width: 0pt, height: 0pt, {
          align(center + horizon)[
            #block(width: size)[
              #if label != none { text(size: size * 0.08, fill: rgb("#64748b"), weight: "bold", upper(label)); v(-8pt) }
              #text(size: size * 0.20, weight: "bold", str(val) + "%")
            ]
          ]
        })
      )
      
      // Min/Max Endcap Indicators
      place(bottom + left, dx: size * 0.05, dy: size * 0.05, text(size: size * 0.08, fill: rgb("#94a3b8"), weight: "medium", "0%"))
      place(bottom + right, dx: -size * 0.05, dy: size * 0.05, text(size: size * 0.08, fill: rgb("#94a3b8"), weight: "medium", str(max-val) + "%"))
    }
  )
}

  
  
// 2. THE COMPACT METRIC BAR INDICATOR (Tight fit layout)
#let bar-indicator(percentage, label: none, color: rgb("#00B0B9")) = {
  let max-val = calc.max(percentage, 100)
  let val = calc.max(percentage, 0)
  let bar-color = color
  
  box(
    stroke: 1pt + rgb("e0e0e0"),
    inset: 15pt,
    radius: 8pt,
    fill: rgb("fafafa"),
    width: 100%,
    [
      // Text Row Layout: Label on Left, Value next to it, Percentage on Right
      #grid(
        columns: (auto, 1fr, auto),
        column-gutter: 8pt,
        text(weight: "bold", size: 12pt, fill: rgb("2c3e50"))[#label],
        align(left + horizon)[#text(size: 11pt, weight: "medium", fill: rgb("#64748b"))[(#val)]],
        align(right + horizon)[#text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1e293b"))[#str(val)%]]
      )
      #v(10pt)
      // Fixed Track Component Layering
      #align(left)[
        #block(
          width: 100%,
          height: 8pt, // Keeping container tightly fit to bar height only
          {
            // 1. Gray Background Track
            place(top + left, rect(width: 100%, height: 8pt, fill: rgb("#e2e8f0"), radius: 4pt))
            
            // 2. Overlapping Progress Strip
            if val > 0 {
              let fill-width = calc.min((val / max-val) * 100, 100)
              place(top + left, rect(width: fill-width * 1%, height: 8pt, fill: bar-color, radius: 4pt))
            }
            
            // 3. Conditional 100% Line Marker & Text Label (Only shows if percentage > 100)
            if percentage > 100 {
              let marker-pos = (100 / max-val) * 100
              
              // Vertical marker line intersecting the bar
              place(
                top + left, 
                dx: marker-pos * 1% - 1pt, 
                dy: -2pt, 
                rect(width: 1.5pt, height: 12pt, fill: rgb("#1e293b"), radius: 1pt)
              )
              
              // Small text indicator overlaid below with absolute positioning (does not push content)
              place(
                top + left,
                dx: marker-pos * 1% - 12pt, 
                dy: 12pt,       
                text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#1e293b"), weight: "bold", "100%")
              )
            }
          }
        )
      ]
    ]
  )
}


// 3. MASTER DASHBOARD WRAPPED IN A BOX
#set align(center)

// #box(stroke: 1pt + rgb("e0e0e0"), inset: 15pt, radius: 8pt, fill: rgb("fafafa"), width: 100%,

#box(
  stroke: 1.5pt + rgb("#cbd5e1"), // Light border line
  inset: 25pt,                    // Padding inside the outer box
  radius: 12pt,                   // Smooth rounded corners
  fill: rgb("#ffffff"),           // Clean background fill
  width: 100%,                    // Spans full width of page margins
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr),
      row-gutter: 40pt,
      
      // First Row: Three Arch Gauges
      grid(
        columns: (auto, auto, auto),
        gutter: 30pt,
        progressive-gauge(50, label: "Volume", color: rgb("#00B0B9")),
        progressive-gauge(82, label: "Overall", color: rgb("#B2C9D4")),
        progressive-gauge(115, label: "Intensity", color: rgb("#572C5F"))
      ),
      
      // Second Row: 3x2 Grid of Left-Aligned Boxed Indicators
      grid(
        columns: (1fr, 1fr),
        column-gutter: 20pt,
        row-gutter: 20pt,
        bar-indicator(35, label: "Total Distance (m)", color: rgb("#00B0B9")),
        bar-indicator(72, label: "Total Distance (m/min)", color: rgb("#572C5F")),
        bar-indicator(94, label: "HSR Distance (m)", color: rgb("#00B0B9")),
        bar-indicator(15, label: "HSR Distance (m/min)", color: rgb("#572C5F")),
        bar-indicator(112, label: "Accel + Decel (#)", color: rgb("#00B0B9")),
        bar-indicator(83, label: "Accel + Decel (#/min)", color: rgb("#572C5F"))
      )
    )
  ]
)
```

```{=typst}
// 1. THE ARCH GAUGE FUNCTION (Tightened inline text stack)
#let progressive-gauge(
  percentage,
  label: none,
  size: 80pt,
  stroke-width: 7pt,
  color: rgb("#00B0B9"),
) = {
  let max-val = calc.max(percentage, 100)
  let val = calc.max(percentage, 0)
  let gauge-color = color
  let center-pt = size / 2
  let radius = (size - stroke-width) / 2
  let start-angle = 135deg
  let total-sweep = 270deg
  let target-100-sweep = (100 / max-val) * total-sweep
  let steps = 60
  
  block(
    width: size,
    height: size,
    {
      // Gray Track
      for i in range(0, steps) {
        let angle1 = start-angle + (i / steps) * total-sweep
        let angle2 = start-angle + ((i + 1) / steps) * total-sweep
        let x1 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle1)
        let y1 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle1)
        let x2 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle2)
        let y2 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle2)
        place(line(start: (x1, y1), end: (x2, y2), stroke: (paint: rgb("#e2e8f0"), thickness: stroke-width, cap: "round")))
      }
      
      // Progress Track
      if val > 0 {
        let fg-steps = calc.ceil((val / max-val) * steps)
        for i in range(0, fg-steps) {
          let t1 = i / steps
          let t2 = calc.min((i + 1) / steps, val / max-val)
          let angle1 = start-angle + t1 * total-sweep
          let angle2 = start-angle + t2 * total-sweep
          let x1 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle1)
          let y1 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle1)
          let x2 = center-pt + radius * calc.cos(angle2)
          let y2 = center-pt + radius * calc.sin(angle2)
          place(line(start: (x1, y1), end: (x2, y2), stroke: (paint: gauge-color, thickness: stroke-width, cap: "round")))
        }
      }
      
      // 100% Target Divider Line
      if percentage > 100 {
        let target-angle = start-angle + target-100-sweep
        let inner-r = radius - (stroke-width * 0.8)
        let outer-r = radius + (stroke-width * 0.8)
        let tx1 = center-pt + inner-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let ty1 = center-pt + inner-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        let tx2 = center-pt + outer-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let ty2 = center-pt + outer-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        place(line(start: (tx1, ty1), end: (tx2, ty2), stroke: (paint: rgb("#1e293b"), thickness: 1.5pt, cap: "round")))
        let text-r = outer-r + 4pt
        let text-x = center-pt + text-r * calc.cos(target-angle)
        let text-y = center-pt + text-r * calc.sin(target-angle)
        place(top + left, dx: text-x, dy: text-y - 3pt, text(size: size * 0.07, fill: rgb("#1e293b"), weight: "bold", "100%"))
      }
      
      // Midpoint Text Stack (Using a single inline text object and linebreaks to kill extra spacing)
      place(
        top + left,
        dx: center-pt,
        dy: center-pt - (size * 0.02), 
        block(width: 0pt, height: 0pt, {
          align(center + horizon)[
            #block(width: size)[
              #text(size: size * 0.20, weight: "bold")[#str(val)%] \
              #if label != none {
                // Tightly micro-managed font block line baseline
                text(size: size * 0.095, fill: rgb("#64748b"), weight: "bold")[#upper(label)]
              }
            ]
          ]
        })
      )
      
      // Min/Max Endcap Indicators
      place(bottom + left, dx: size * 0.05, dy: size * 0.05, text(size: size * 0.08, fill: rgb("#94a3b8"), weight: "medium", "0%"))
      place(bottom + right, dx: -size * 0.05, dy: size * 0.05, text(size: size * 0.08, fill: rgb("#94a3b8"), weight: "medium", str(max-val) + "%"))
    }
  )
}
```
